hypotheses.claim: Ranking candidate route merges by the static merge score before executing the parallel merge will produce lower total CVRP distance than unranked/naive merging, because costly merges are deferred and cheap feasible merges are applied first.

next_search_advice.direction: Use the static score-based merge ordering (score_merge_static) to prioritize route pairs whose merge yields the smallest added distance, and keep the parallel merge schedule fixed rather than adaptive, so the 500 ms budget is spent on evaluating high-quality candidate merges.
